skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Gate 3 — Profile the entity, then interview the user': 'never default a framework, a current / non-current split, a rounding basis, or a share count', yet the manual upload checklist and intake never force these answers; on an upload run every package is therefore a draft and the skill gives no instruction for how to lay out statements while the framework is open (this run had to fall back to the generic 'show the result under each answer' rule).

SKILL.md 'Step 4 — Add comparative period' covers annual comparatives only; it is silent on interim packages, where the balance sheet compares to the prior year-end but the income statement should compare to the same YTD period of the prior year. Nothing tells the run to ask for that prior-YTD TB.

SKILL.md 'Step 1 — Validate the TB' and 'Edge Cases' handle a post-closing current TB but not a pre-closing comparative TB, where the prior year's net income (633,096 here) must be rolled into retained earnings before the comparative balance sheet balances.

SKILL.md 'Step 6' and 'Step 7' hand the cash flow and equity statements to other skills, but tie-outs 2–5 in 'Step 8' depend on them; on an upload run with only this skill there is no instruction whether to draft them inline.

SKILL.md is a single 1,152-line file; the manual-run rules ('After an upload, validate the input before any work', 'The coverage sheet on a manual run') are buried in the shared scope block while 'Step 11 — Output' Sheet 9 still specifies Mosofin-only columns.
sample_defects: No income tax in either TB and no tax account in the chart for a Ltd company: profit before tax 4,038,600 − 2,370,856 − 1,045,029 − 17,100 = 605,615 with nil tax; the key does not mention it.

No TB for the nine months to 30 Sep 2024, so the key's 'December 2024 as the comparative balance sheet' leaves the income-statement comparative undefined; the only prior P&L is 12 months (revenue 4,597,600).

Eight balance-sheet accounts are identical at both dates (e.g. Stripe clearing 6,420, payroll clearing 1,200, prepaid 18,000 with no insurance expense) — stale-looking data the key does not acknowledge.
summary: PASS 1/1; Harlow TB rejected on content. Gaps: skill has no interim-comparative rule, and the sample has no tax and no 9-month 2024 comparative.
